<div class="card-body">
'''I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">信念への中傷は不愉快だ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、自分のダーク・ジェダイに配備する。その場に敵ジェダイがいないならば、敵の能力値の合計は－２される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-217o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ダース・ベイダーは、自分の気分を害した者を、敵味方の区別をつけず、フォースを使って容赦なく打ち倒す。指一本触れないで、犠牲者の首を締めるのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Slander against the faith is unpleasant.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on one of your Dark Jedi. If no opposing Jedi is there, the opponent's total ability is reduced by 2.

'''Lore:''' Darth Vader uses the Force to strike down anyone who offends him, friend or foe, without mercy. He can choke a victim without laying a finger on them.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' If no opposing Jedi is there, the opponent's total ability is -2. The English reduces total ability at the same location by 2 unless an opponent's Jedi is also present.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
